expect.query: Polícia Nacional de Timor Leste Comando Município de Dili

notes: Caicoli, Dili. Blue name board on the compound wall, small in the frame and slightly soft. No accent is discernible on MUNICIPIO. The phone number after 'Tel :' looks like 3311380 but is too blurred to confirm, so it is left out. Badge above reads 'POLICIA NACIONAL' (tiny). A parked SUV with plate in the foreground is incidental, not the subject. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.text: 1º Andar, Edificio Central de Caicoli, Av. Martires de Patria, Dili, Timor-Leste

notes: Caicoli, Dili. Yellow name board between white posts, small in a wide shady photo (fence and tree in the foreground). The address strip is small; its first word is '1º Andar' (the ordinal mark is tiny), and the accents in Edifício/Mártires/Pátria are absent on the sign. Parked cars incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
